title: Dimensions: Dreadnought Architect
description:
Design
Design your spaceship with a variety of modules. Each module has unique properties and functions. You need to design your ship with a clear strategy, balancing maneuverability, durability, firepower, cargo space, power supply, and other aspects.

Customize
You have complete freedom to control the three-dimensional size of the modules and configure custom colors for each module. Note that the size of the module will affect its attribute parameters.

Command
You need to strategically command your ship, set the whole ship’s tactical strategy according to the battlefield situation. For example, set the direction and attitude of navigation, change the turret attack strategy, arrange the priority of energy supply, or even use unique skills to reverse the battlefield situation.

Physics Simulation
The game has a highly realistic physics system. If the key module nodes of the ship are destroyed, the structure of the ship will break. The thrust and torque of the thrusters are calculated independently, and the placement position and direction directly determine the acceleration and maneuverability of the ship.

Start an Adventure
Choose an initial battleship, gallop in the vast galaxy, win victory in battles, and continuously upgrade and strengthen your battleship.

Play With Friends
You can invite your friends for a fun LAN battle, you can fight against AI enemies together, or have a fair competition to see whose battleship is the stronger design!
description_short: Unleash your creativity, design your dreadnought with a variety of modules, and have complete control over the function and style of each module. Command your battleship with wisdom and decisiveness. Gallop in the vast galaxy and destroy all enemies.
